trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Reduction dimension width is exactly 781 with row count greater than 1
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Input tensor on CUDA with dtype torch.float64 and shape (c, 781), where c > 1; softmax applied along dim=1.

root_cause.aten_layer: ATen native CUDA softmax implementation in aten/src/ATen/native/cuda/SoftMax.cu is suspected
root_cause.kernel_layer: CUDA vectorized float64 softmax kernel boundary condition

bug_oracle.description: Softmax produces incorrect output for CUDA float64 tensors with shape (c, 781) and c > 1.
bug_oracle.signal: Output rows differ from reference softmax or do not sum to 1 within tolerance

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Sweep reduction dimension widths around CUDA vectorization boundaries and vary row counts above 1
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct CUDA float64 tensors with shapes such as (rows, width) and initialize with known values such as zeros or constant vectors
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force dtype=torch.float64, device='cuda', and softmax dim=1
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run torch.softmax(input, dim=1) and compare with CPU float64 reference and float32 CUDA reference
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Verify that each output row sums to 1 within a small tolerance and matches the reference softmax distribution
